bioconda.name: r-ukbrapr
bioconda.summary: R functions to use in the UK Biobank Research Analysis Platform (RAP)
bioconda.description: R functions to use in the UK Biobank Research Analysis Platform (RAP). The aim is to make working in the RAP quicker, easier, and more reproducible. Though some functions require a Spark cluster, the package is mostly aimed to work in a "normal" cluster using RStudio, and raw UK Biobank data from the table-exporter.
